resources.string: ʻAe i nā polokalamu hoa i kau inoa ʻia me ke kī hoʻokahi e heluhelu i ka ʻikepili ana olakino mai iā Bios.
ʻAe i nā polokalamu hoa i kau inoa ʻia me ke kī hoʻokahi e kākau i nā hōʻailona i helu ʻia (ka pana kikokiko, ka māhele pō a me ke ao, ka helu neʻe) iā Bios.
He leka mai ka mea hana polokalamu
Ua hana ʻia ʻo Bios e ke kanaka hoʻokahi a he manuahi ia, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha, ʻaʻohe hahai, ʻaʻohe pae uku. Inā ua kōkua ʻo ia iā ʻoe, eia nā ala ʻekolu e kōkua ai i kona holomua.
